subject: science
cluster: The solar system and Earth's history
skillName: Orbital Motion in the Solar System

items.prompt:
Planets orbit the Sun because of
A) the Sun's gravity
B) wind
C) magnetism only
D) sound

A moon orbits a planet because of the
A) planet's gravity
B) Sun's heat
C) moon's light
D) wind

steps: A planet's gravity holds its moon.

items.prompt:
Planets closer to the Sun orbit
A) faster
B) slower
C) backward
D) not at all

A planet farther from the Sun than Earth has a year that is
A) longer than Earth's
B) shorter than Earth's
C) exactly one day
D) the same as Earth's

Because orbits are regular and repeating, we can
A) predict where an object will be
B) never know their motion
C) stop them
D) change their path easily
items.answer: A) predict where an object will be

items.prompt:
A planet that takes 80 years to orbit is
A) far from the Sun
B) very close to the Sun
C) a moon of Earth
D) the Sun itself

steps: A long orbit means it is far away.

items.prompt:
We can predict a planet's position next year because
A) it orbits in a fixed, repeating time we can calculate from
B) planets move randomly
C) gravity turns off
D) orbits never repeat
items.answer: A) it orbits in a fixed, repeating time we can calculate from

items.prompt:
The pattern linking distance and orbit time is that the farther a planet is, the
A) longer it takes to orbit
B) shorter its year
C) faster it moves
D) less gravity matters
items.answer: A) longer it takes to orbit

steps: Distance and orbit time increase together.
